source.notes: Chiba and Tool Camp face a common courtyard, Freeside sits west, and Bodywork closes the eastern side. A roof-plane fit of the January panorama constrains placement and orientation. Staggered stairs, roof artwork, facades and a dated 21-vehicle census use labeled sources; measurements and hidden details remain approximate.
limitations: Rack bays set to nominal 12 ft. Photographic placement is approximate; this is not a measured inventory or survey.

bands.note: low prisms = geometry within the ground body band; .up = above it (overhead). No walkable decks/stairs: none are declared by the procedural scene.
